rows.resolution_note: p001 sentence 2 attributes the pQTLs to UKB-PPP with citation 14 (Sun 2023, DOI 10.1038/s41586-023-06592-6, the source of four pqtl rows); the adjacent sentence 3, one description with it (rule F), takes the instruments 'from the complete UKB-PPP cohort', the subcohort attribute that separates the full cohort from discovery, replication and ancestry-specific (rule E). The 54 219 individuals of sentence 2 equals no row's N and is not a conflict (rule H). Note for the gates: the citation mark is in sentence 2, the separating attribute in the pinned sentence 3.
rows.quote: We used only the sentinel cis-pQTL with the lowest P value (P<1.7×10−11) from the complete UKB-PPP cohort for each protein as IVs to reduce the risk of horizontal pleiotropy.
